text:
maria: heads-up — noticed an odd spike in fallback routing correlated with the new 'deprecation banner' rollout in Console. numbers: ~15% extra traffic going to v1 fallback during the banner experiment window.

sam: ugh. do we have an easy signal that ties requests to the banner exposure?

maria: Not today. console shows impression counts but we don't propagate a header or tag into requests. telemetry just sees downstream behavior.

ashok: if banner => user clicks 'continue', client reauth + new header? maybe we can set `X-Console-Banner=1` for requests initiated after the banner flow.

tia: that would help attribution, but risk: any change to headers can affect cache keys / routing affinity. we need to be careful.

sam: important point. the fallback router currently keys on `client_version` and token hash only. adding `X-Console-Banner` could create a new route dimension (bad).

maria: proposal: don't change routing keys. instead have the Console attach an event id in `X-Console-Event` purely for telemetry (router ignores it). the backend telemetry pipeline can join request ids to impressions and compute conditional fallback probabilities.

ashok: we can do that quickly — router ignores unknown headers by default. but the telemetry join requires consistent request_id. are we already propagating a stable `x-request-id` from the client?

tia: clients set `x-rw-req` in most flows, but some legacy flows don't. we should ensure Console sets the same header and log it. then our ETL can join on `x-rw-req`.

sam: tactical mitigation: reduce fallback aggressiveness for the banner cohort. e.g., change fallback threshold for sessions that originated from the Console banner to 95% (i.e., only trigger fallback on clear errors) for first 1,000 requests. This avoids mass routing churn while we gather signals.

maria: yes — a soft-fallback flag. Implementation plan: (1) Console will set `x-rw-req` and `x-console-cohort=banner_v1` on requests started from the banner (for telemetry only). (2) Router will accept header but NOT include it in route hashing. (3) Routing service will have an opt-in rule: if `x-console-cohort=banner_v1` then use soft fallback policy for N requests per tenant.

ashok: can we implement (3) without changing persistent route keys? router config supports ephemeral rule evals today (based on headers) so yes. but need to add sampling cap — otherwise attackers could spoof header. we should only trust header when it is accompanied by a valid signed console token (we have `console-sig` header) or when it originates from Console IPs.

tia: agreed — add server-side verification: console signs `x-console-cohort` with `console-sig`. router rejects cohort header without valid sig.

sam: telemetry work: create a dashboard slice that shows fallback rate conditioned on `x-console-cohort` and `client_version`. also show latency and quota delta. i can stub the query: `SELECT cohort, client_version, count(*) as requests, sum(fallback) as fallbacks FROM requests WHERE timestamp >= now()-1d GROUP BY cohort, client_version`

maria: sgtm. can we also add a one-off alert for quota burn > 10% delta in a 1h window for tenants with banner cohort traffic? want to catch surprises.

ashok: i'll add the alert rule. but for the rollout: timeline?

maria: timeline: today — Console sets headers on experiment traffic (no route changes). infra implements header verification and soft-fallback rule (canary tomorrow). telemetry dashboard and alert run in parallel. full canary 24h after canary signs look normal.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: infra/fallback-soft-rule v1.1 -> canary cluster at 2023-07-21T15:10Z

tia: one more UX note: Console copy should say "temporary compatibility mode" instead of just "continue" so we don't accidentally direct people to keep older clients. marketing will check.

maria: good catch. i'll loop in @marketing later. for now, priority is instrumentation + safe soft-fallback.

sam: sounds like a plan. i'll own the telemetry dashboard and the query. ashok, tia — can you pair on the router verification?

ashok: yup. i'll start a PR for header verification and the ephemeral rule.

tia: starting a console patch to set headers + sig for banner cohort. will post link when live.

maria: thanks all. update here when the canary metrics look stable. :thumbsup:
